value.name: affirm shared search for stories
value.description: Rosa agrees with Lucia that they will uncover the stories tied to their mother and hold onto love as they do so.
evidence: Rosa: "Yes, Lucia, and as we uncover those stories, let’s hold onto the love that binds us; it will be our anchor as we navigate through the memories and secrets she left for us."

value.name: resolve to face what lies ahead
value.description: Lucia and Rosa commit to confronting whatever comes next together, drawing strength from their bond and their mother's love.
evidence: Lucia: "Together, we can face whatever lies ahead, Rosa; I feel our mother’s love wrapped around us like a protective thread, urging us to be brave and uncover the truths that will help us honor her legacy."
Rosa: "Then let us be brave, Lucia; for in every truth we uncover, we will find not only her legacy but also the strength of our bond—together, we can face whatever comes next."

value.name: sense mother's spirit in room
value.description: Lucia feels their mother's spirit present in the room, as if urging them to uncover the truth despite fear.
evidence: Lucia: "I can feel the weight of her spirit in this room, Rosa; it's as if she's urging us to uncover everything, even if it means confronting our deepest fears."
Rosa: "Yes, Lucia, her spirit is here with us; we must not shy away from the shadows but embrace them, for within lies the light of her love waiting to guide us."

value.name: choose to embrace the shadows
value.description: The sisters decide together to confront hidden truths and refuse to let fear control their path.
evidence: Lucia: "Then let's embrace the shadows together, Rosa; I refuse to let fear dictate our path—our mother's love deserves to be honored, no matter how daunting the truth may be."
Rosa: "Exactly, Lucia; we owe it to her to seek out every hidden truth, for it is in those truths that we will find our way back to each other and to the essence of who she was."

value.name: decide to follow mother's clues
value.description: Lucia concludes that their mother left clues for a reason and commits to following them for both her mother's sake and their own.
evidence: Lucia: "I know it won't be easy, but I can’t shake the feeling that our mother left us these clues for a reason; we owe it to her—and to ourselves—to follow where they lead."

value.name: frame clues as connected threads
value.description: Rosa describes each clue as part of a larger fabric, implying the investigation will reveal a connected truth.
